facts.fact: The Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II, 2015/16-2019/20) is stated adopted by the Statistics Council; the document gives no adoption date, so the July 2016 publication date is used.
The preface states a mid-term and a final evaluation of NSDS I (2010/11-2014/15) was conducted with PARIS21, AfDB and ECA; no evaluation date is given, so the July 2016 publication date is used.
